description: Spain publishes the national register of public electric vehicle charging points as a DATEX II version 3 EnergyInfrastructureTablePublication on the DGT National Access Point for traffic and mobility, sourced from the ecological transition ministry (MITERD). Contents: on 29 September 2026 the file held 12,031 energy infrastructure sites and 35,530 refill points, each site with operator, location coordinates and address, opening times, and each refill point with connector types, power and charging mode, following the DATEX II energy infrastructure profile. Producer: MITERD with data from charge point operators, published by DGT. Coverage: public charging points across Spain. Format and access: a single DATEX II XML file (83 MB) at a stable URL, publication time 28 September 2026, no registration. Licence: CC BY as listed on the access point. Caveats: the file is a current snapshot without history, real-time availability is not included, and completeness depends on operator reporting. Simulation uses: siting and capacity planning for charging networks, coupling transport electrification scenarios with distribution grid load models, and range feasibility in routing and evacuation studies. Related records: the Spain DGT national access point (data-spain-dgt-national-access-point-traffic-mobility-datex2) lists the other traffic feeds, and the DATEX II standard (data-datex-ii-standard) defines the format.
